findings.title: Use === and !==, never == or !=
findings.message: Replace loose equality operators (== and !=) with strict equality (=== and !==). Loose equality performs type coercion that hides bugs. The diff replaces five strict equality checks with loose equality checks: 'order.status == "pending"', 'order.couponCode != null', 'order.user.role == "admin"', 'order.tier != "free"', and 'order.shippingMethod == "express"'. Revert these changes back to strict equality operators.
